title: Fractional Navier-Stokes Equations with Caputo Derivative Driven by Hermite Noise
summary: We study time-fractional stochastic Navier-Stokes equations on a bounded domain of $\R^2$, driven by a cylindrical Hermite noise of order $k\ge1$ and Hurst parameter $H\in(1/2,1)$, built mode-by-mode on the eigenbasis of the Stokes operator. This class of noises generalizes fractional Brownian motion ($k=1$) and the Rosenblatt process ($k=2$) to arbitrary non-Gaussian order. Combining Wiener-chaos hypercontractivity with Hilbert-Schmidt estimates for the Mittag-Leffler operator, we establish the regularity of the associated stochastic convolution.
